decision: Keep original Web source. Stopping its publication must not remove the frozen inputs owned by the Cocos/shared art pipeline. Relocation requires a separate byte-preserving change and regression evidence before archive/delete authorization.

owners.responsibility: Canonical engine-independent behavior and descriptive records; edit here, sync generated Cocos core. Keep in shared/game long term.
Authoritative geography and its imported modules. Remain in backend; offline art reads these without modifying rules.
Immutable original project-generated artwork and exact prompts/layouts. Remain in project art archive; never bundle source packs.
Reproducible runtime-sized PNG and pixel-identical lossless WebP derivatives. Root art tools own regeneration; preserve source/processing evidence.
Existing immutable original generated departure cutouts/prompts. Retain as provenance source; never infer third-party licensing.
Existing provenance and reference records; approval scope belongs to its task, not a successful byte check.

Project art inputs owned by shared/Cocos art tooling despite the legacy directory name. Retain in place during transition; before any frontend archive/delete move exact bytes and provenance to a shared project asset source and update both consumers.

Frozen project-authored offline paint sources and import/data closure. Root bake tool owns their continued availability. No React build or installed Phaser is required; before archive/delete extract exact sources into shared offline art tooling, preserve Web wrappers/behavior and rerun pixel/layout checks.

Retain original assertions against canonical shared helpers. Before frontend archive/delete relocate test ownership to shared tooling while preserving the original assertions and preservation evidence.
Native Cocos adapters, templates, explicit source bindings and generated copies. Generated core/resources are owned by their canonical source, never hand-maintained game rules.
Project-owned export, inventory and validation tools using root locked dependencies; retain independently of publishing Web.
Pinned root tooling; version and install checks remain T3/T2 evidence.
Explicit ownership and preserved-source contracts; review changes instead of weakening guards to hide drift.
Cocos-only static runtime packaging templates and pinned official base provenance. Independent of original Web image or deployment switch.
Explicit Cocos-only candidate CI; actual committed runner execution remains T2/T3 evidence, no production publishing.

reference_scope: All TS/MJS/PY files in shared/game, clients/cocos/assets/scripts and clients/cocos/tools; root cocos-*.mjs/test-cocos-*.mjs; every producer recorded by the consumed art provenance. Static strings/template prefixes and real bake module input closure are checked. This is not an arbitrary-JavaScript data-flow proof.
scope_limits: Optional two-client Web comparison and historical Git preservation guards remain separate. No engine change, source deletion, default publication switch, new license or owner visual approval follows from this inventory.
